features: WIDE COMPATIBILITY: This USB-C/Type-C to 3.5mm adapter works seamlessly with a wide range of USB-C devices, including most phones, tablets, and laptops. It's compatible with iPhone 15 models, Samsung Galaxy models like S24, S23, S22, S21, Note series, Google Pixel models (7, 6, 5, 4), iPad mini 6, iPad Pro, iPad Air, iMac, MacBook Pro 2023, MacBook Air 2022, OnePlus (10, 9, 8), and even PS5, supporting most USB-C devices.

HIGH-PERFORMANCE CX31993 DAC CHIPSET: The AUDIOCULAR Type-C adapter includes the Hi-Res CX31993 DAC chipset, delivering high-resolution audio up to 32-bit/384kHz. It enhances sound quality and is compatible with various headphones, IEMs, and earphones for a deeply immersive audio experience.

ENHANCED AUDIO WITH MAX97220 AMPLIFIER CHIP: The D07 Audio Type C adapter includes two key components: the DAC Decoding Chip, which clarifies digital sound, and the MAX97220 Amplifier Chip, which boosts audio power, particularly for high-quality headphones. Together, they deliver a superior audio experience for music enthusiasts.

MULTI-FUNCTION DONGLE WITH IN-LINE CONTROL: This USB-C to 3.5mm audio adapter lets you enjoy music or take calls seamlessly with connected earphones. Designed to enhance audio quality, it effectively filters out noise and interference for clear sound during calls and music playback.
DURABLE ALUMINUM ALLOY SHELL: The Type-C to 3.5mm DAC dongle is crafted from premium aluminum alloy, offering a sleek, compact, and sturdy design.
